summary_en: This study tests 131I-Apamistamab, given before a CD19-targeted CAR-T cell therapy, in adults with relapsed or refractory diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (non-Hodgkin lymphoma). Patients receive a single 50 mCi dose of 131I-Apamistamab 5 to 7 days before a single CAR-T cell infusion. The main outcome is not stated; the record says the study aims to determine safety, efficacy and tolerability, and it is listed as Phase 1/Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa 131I-Apamistamab, administrado antes de una terapia con células CAR-T dirigida a CD19, en adultos con linfoma difuso de células B grandes recidivante o refractario (linfoma no Hodgkin). Los pacientes reciben una dosis única de 50 mCi de 131I-Apamistamab de 5 a 7 días antes de una única infusión de células CAR-T. El resultado principal no se indica; el registro dice que el estudio busca determinar la seguridad, la eficacia y la tolerabilidad, y figura como Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory DLBCL or high-grade B-cell lymphoma after at least one chemoimmunotherapy regimen that included an anthracycline and CD20-directed therap
Relapse or refractory disease confirmed by a repeat biopsy within the last 12 months.
Considered a candidate for standard CAR-T therapy.
not_for: Active autoimmune disease or active graft versus host disease needing systemic T-cell suppressive therapy.
Positive HIV, hepatitis B or hepatitis C test, with listed exceptions.
Prior treatment with radiopharmaceuticals for a lymphoma indication.
